articles.title: Legal and regulatory requirements involving AI are understood, managed, and documented.
articles.rationale: Reviewed mapping to NIST AI RMF 1.0 GOVERN-1.1 for documenting applicable legal, regulatory, and policy context for AI risk management.

articles.title: The characteristics of trustworthy AI are integrated into organizational policies, processes, procedures, and practices.
articles.rationale: Pack mapping to NIST AI RMF GOVERN-1.2.

articles.title: Processes, procedures, and practices are in place to determine the needed level of risk management activities based on the organization’s risk tolerance.
articles.rationale: Pack mapping to NIST AI RMF GOVERN-1.3.

articles.title: The risk management process and its outcomes are established through transparent policies, procedures, and other controls based on organizational risk priorities.
articles.rationale: Pack mapping to NIST AI RMF GOVERN-1.4.

articles.title: Ongoing monitoring and periodic review of the risk management process and its outcomes are planned and organizational roles and responsibilities clearly defined, including determining the frequency of periodic review.
articles.rationale: Pack mapping to NIST AI RMF GOVERN-1.5.

articles.title: Mechanisms are in place to inventory AI systems and are resourced according to organizational risk priorities.
articles.rationale: Reviewed mapping to NIST AI RMF 1.0 GOVERN-1.6 for maintaining AI system inventory context and risk prioritization evidence.

articles.title: Processes and procedures are in place for decommissioning and phasing out AI systems safely and in a manner that does not increase risks or decrease the organization’s trustworthiness.
articles.rationale: Pack mapping to NIST AI RMF GOVERN-1.7.

articles.title: Roles and responsibilities and lines of communication related to mapping, measuring, and managing AI risks are documented and are clear to individuals and teams throughout the organization.
articles.rationale: Pack mapping to NIST AI RMF GOVERN-2.1.

articles.title: The organization’s personnel and partners receive AI risk management training to enable them to perform their duties and responsibilities consistent with related policies, procedures, and agreements.
articles.rationale: Pack mapping to NIST AI RMF GOVERN-2.2.

articles.title: Executive leadership of the organization takes responsibility for decisions about risks associated with AI system development and deployment.
articles.rationale: Pack mapping to NIST AI RMF GOVERN-2.3.

articles.title: Decision-making related to mapping, measuring, and managing AI risks throughout the lifecycle is informed by a diverse team (e.g., diversity of demographics, disciplines, experience, expertise, and backgrounds).
articles.rationale: Pack mapping to NIST AI RMF GOVERN-3.1.

articles.title: Policies and procedures are in place to define and differentiate roles and responsibilities for human-AI configurations and oversight of AI systems.
articles.rationale: Pack mapping to NIST AI RMF GOVERN-3.2.

articles.title: Organizational policies and practices are in place to foster a critical thinking and safety-first mindset in the design, development, deployment, and uses of AI systems to minimize potential negative impacts.
articles.rationale: Pack mapping to NIST AI RMF GOVERN-4.1.

articles.title: Organizational teams document the risks and potential impacts of the AI technology they design, develop, deploy, evaluate, and use, and they communicate about the impacts more broadly.
articles.rationale: Pack mapping to NIST AI RMF GOVERN-4.2.

articles.title: Organizational practices are in place to enable AI testing, identification of incidents, and information sharing.
articles.rationale: Pack mapping to NIST AI RMF GOVERN-4.3.

articles.title: Organizational policies and practices are in place to collect, consider, prioritize, and integrate feedback from those external to the team that developed or deployed the AI system regarding the potential individual and societal impacts rel
articles.rationale: Pack mapping to NIST AI RMF GOVERN-5.1.

articles.title: Mechanisms are established to enable the team that developed or deployed AI systems to regularly incorporate adjudicated feedback from relevant AI actors into system design and implementation.
articles.rationale: Pack mapping to NIST AI RMF GOVERN-5.2.
